data.desc: Rexford Industrial (NYSE: REXR) transforms industrial real estate that powers the world's goods, fueling businesses, communities and everyday life. Focused exclusively on infill Southern California, the Company's portfolio of highly functional industrial properties serves the local consumption base of one of the world's largest and most economically diverse industrial markets. Through its operational expertise and disciplined execution, the Company drives value creation and long-term shareholder value. Rexford Industrial is a real estate investment trust and a member of the S&P MidCap 400 Index. For more information, please visit rexfordindustrial.com.
